name: Acne
overview: Acne is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, typical features of the condition include blackheads or whiteheads, pimples, oily skin, and possible scarring.
In routine practice, it primarily affects skin with a relatively high number of oil glands, including the face, upper part of the chest, and back.
In routine practice, the resulting appearance can lead to lack of confidence, anxiety, reduced self-esteem, and, in extreme cases, depression or thoughts of suicide.
